response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS overall_average FROM type_averages HAVING AVG(type_average) IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.type_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_average > b.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_of_kept FROM kept), remaining AS (SELECT k.type_average, b.overall_average, m.average_of_kept FROM kept k CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_average > m.average_of_kept) SELECT AVG(r.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(r.type_average - r.overall_average) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(r.type_average - r.average_of_kept) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b LEFT JOIN remaining r ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY b.overall_average

assumptions.assumption: Types with no non-NULL unit_price have no type average and are excluded from the baseline.
